user.title: Connect to the Axis camera
user.description: Enter the address and credentials of the camera. The integration reads the camera configuration and creates its own stream profile. Existing profiles and global camera settings are left untouched.

error.cannot_connect: The camera could not be reached at that address.
error.invalid_auth: The camera rejected the username or password.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This camera is already set up.

init.title: Stream settings
init.description: These values are written to the HomeAssistant stream profile only. Other stream profiles and the global camera settings are not changed.

data_description.compression: Axis recommends 30. Higher values mean stronger compression.
data_description.videozstrength: Read from the camera. Higher values save more bandwidth.
data_description.videozfpsmode: Dynamic lowers the frame rate when there is little motion. Some clients may make this look like a frozen stream.
data_description.videozgopmode: Dynamic can produce long keyframe intervals, which some players handle poorly. Fixed works everywhere.
